name: llm_query
description: Query ANY external LLM using an OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint (e.g. Dahl, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Groq, Ollama, LM Studio, FreeLLMAPI, 9Router, OmniRoute, or any custom endpoint). Supports reasoning/thinking extraction, custom system prompts, and ad-hoc endpoint overrides.

api_key.description: Ad-hoc API key to use with the endpoint_url or provider.

endpoint_url.description: Ad-hoc OpenAI-compatible /v1 base URL (e.g., "https://inference.dahl.global/v1" or "http://localhost:11434/v1"). Overrides the provider vault.

model.description: The specific model name/ID (e.g., "MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2.7", "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731", "deepseek-reasoner", "llama-3.3-70b-versatile"). If omitted, uses the provider default.

prompt.description: The user prompt or query to send to the model.

provider.description: The provider alias to use from vault: "dahl", "openrouter", "deepseek", "groq", "ollama", "lmstudio", "freellmapi", "9router", "omniroute", "cerebras", or custom name. Defaults to active provider.

system_prompt.description: Optional system instructions or role specification.
